prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 2 by 2 texture atlas containing four different straight-on rear walls of old European harbour warehouse storage rooms, for a game interior-mapping shader. Four equal square cells, two across and two down, no borders or padding or captions. Each cell shows ONLY a perfectly front-facing flat rear wall elevation, from floor line at the very bottom to ceiling line at the very top. No perspective, no visible side walls, no visible floor plane, no window frame, no glass, no foreground mullions. Top left: soot-stained pale plaster with low stacks of dark timber shipping crates and a tall plain wooden rack on the right. Top right: dark old red brick rear wall with two shallow shelves holding sparse burlap sacks and worn wooden boxes, large empty wall space. Bottom left: weathered cream limewash wall with a closed vertical-plank timber service door off centre and a few crates along the base. Bottom right: grey-brown plaster rear wall with a simple heavy timber horizontal beam near the ceiling and a low stack of burlap sacks and pallets. Restrained realistic warehouse furnishings, no people, no modern office items. Dim diffuse indoor daylight, neutral low-contrast ambient shading, no bright lamps or shafts of sun. Muted brown, grey, chalk and brick colours, detailed natural material wear, physically plausible photographic textures. Each image fills its complete square cell with a warehouse rear wall. Equal 2x2 layout, at 2048 square or higher. No text or branding or labels.
